title: KNOU-Flood: Advancing global streamflow forecasting with lead-aware probabilistic machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20640v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Global streamflow forecasting supports flood preparedness, yet data-driven models trained on reanalysis lose skill when driven by operational forecasts, increasingly so with lead time. AIFL addresses this shift with a two-stage transfer-learning recipe and a deterministic LSTM, but it feeds one forecast lead time into the whole input window and gives no uncertainty. We ask how far this open recipe can be extended without changing its recurrent core. KNOU-Flood keeps a single-layer LSTM and the two-stage training and changes the information around it: a longer input window (424 days), lead-aware forecast inputs, GraphCast as a second forecast source next to ECMWF HRES, and a latent-noise ensemble trained with the fair CRPS. We compare against a re-implementation of the AIFL recipe (its code is not public) under identical data, stations, splits and metrics. Our contributions are threefold. translated_title: KNOU-Flood：利用预见期感知的概率机器学习推进全球径流预报
translated_abstract: 全球径流预报为洪水防范提供支持，然而基于再分析数据训练的数据驱动模型在使用业务预报驱动时性能会下降，且随预见期的增加而愈发明显。AIFL通过两阶段迁移学习方案和确定性LSTM来应对这一转变，但它仅将单一预报预见期输入整个输入窗口，且不提供不确定性信息。我们探究在不改变其循环核心的情况下，这一开放方案能够扩展到何种程度。KNOU-Flood保留了单层LSTM和两阶段训练，并改变其周边的信息：更长的输入窗口（424天）、预见期感知的预报输入、将GraphCast作为ECMWF HRES之外的第二个预报来源，以及使用fair CRPS训练的潜在噪声集成。我们在相同的数据、站点、数据划分和评估指标下，与AIFL方案的重新实现（其代码未公开）进行比较。我们的贡献有三方面。第一，在三个随机种子和2,099个测试流域（202……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: KNOU-Flood在不改变LSTM循环核心的前提下，通过延长输入窗口（424天）、引入预见期感知的预报输入、增加GraphCast作为第二预报来源，以及采用基于fair CRPS训练的潜在噪声集成，将开放的两阶段全球径流预报方案扩展为具有不确定性量化的概率预报。
en_tdlr: KNOU-Flood extends the open AIFL global streamflow forecasting recipe without altering its single-layer LSTM core, by using a longer 424-day input window, lead-aware forecast inputs, GraphCast as a second forecast source alongside ECMWF HRES, and latent-noise ensembles trained with the fair CRPS, thereby delivering probabilistic forecasts with uncertainty quantification.
